## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| **Input** | **10 ng** genomic DNA (1 ng µL⁻¹ in 10 mM Tris-HCl) |
| **Output** | Dual-indexed WGBS library, ~15 µL, QC'd by Qubit and D5000 TapeStation |
| **Kit** | Zymo Pico Methyl-Seq Library Prep Kit + KAPA Pure Beads |
| **Time** | 1.5 days: dilution + conversion in the afternoon (overnight stop), then cleanup through QC the next day |
| **Tested on** | *Porites astreoides* adults and larvae |

This is an adapted workflow, not a replacement for the kit manual. Follow the [Zymo Pico Methyl-Seq manual](https://www.zymoresearch.com/products/pico-methyl-seq-library-prep-kit) for the full reagent details. The changes from the manual are **10 ng input** (instead of 1 ng) with **fewer amplification cycles**, and a diluted polymerase so you never pipette 0.3 µL.

```{mermaid}
flowchart LR
  A[10 ng DNA] --> B[Bisulfite<br/>conversion]
  B --> C[Column<br/>cleanup]
  C --> D[PrepAmp<br/>random priming]
  D --> E[DCC]
  E --> F[Amp 1<br/>8 cycles]
  F --> G[DCC]
  G --> H[Amp 2 + UDI index<br/>10 cycles]
  H --> I[1× bead<br/>cleanup]
  I --> J[(Qubit +<br/>TapeStation)]
```

## Materials

- Zymo Pico Methyl-Seq Library Prep Kit; KAPA Pure Beads (Roche)
- Unique dual index (UDI) i5/i7 primers, 10 µM. Plan the pairs before you start (see Before you start)
- 10 mM Tris-HCl pH 8.0; 100% ethanol (fresh 80% each day); ultrapure water
- Thermocycler, thermomixer (56 °C), microcentrifuge (16,000 × g), magnetic plate for PCR strips, tube rotator/shaker
- PCR strip tubes, 1.5 mL tubes, filter tips
- Qubit dsDNA BR assay; Agilent TapeStation with **D5000** ScreenTape and reagents

## Before you start

- **Dilute DNA** to 1 ng µL⁻¹ in 10 mM Tris-HCl. Calculate all dilutions ahead of time.
- **Plan indexes**: every library gets a unique i5 *and* a unique i7. Don't reuse an index number within a pool, even in a different pairing (this limits index hopping). Putnam Lab UDI list: [UDI index primer pairs](https://github.com/Putnam-Lab/Lab_Management/blob/master/Lab_Resourses/DNA_RNA-protocols/Indexes_and_Barcodes/UDI_Index_Primer_Pairs_for_Pico_WGBS.csv).
- **Thermocycler programs** to save: BS conversion, PrepAmp priming, Amp 1 and Amp 2 (cycle numbers below).
- Work out *n* = number of samples + ~5% for every master mix.
- While each step runs, prepare the master mixes for the next step on ice.

## Procedure

### Day 1: Bisulfite conversion

1. In PCR strips: **10 µL DNA (10 ng)** + **10 µL 10 mM Tris-HCl** = 20 µL.
2. Add **130 µL Lightning Conversion Reagent** (150 µL total). Vortex and spin down.
3. Run: **98 °C 8 min → 54 °C 60 min → 4 °C hold** (~1.5 h).

::: {.callout-tip}
## ⏸ Safe stopping point
Converted DNA is stable at 4 °C for up to 20 h. Stop here overnight.
:::

### Day 2

**Post-conversion column cleanup**

4. Add **600 µL M-Binding Buffer** to a spin column, then the whole 150 µL conversion. Cap, invert 5–10×, spin 30 s. Discard flow-through into the kit's hazardous-waste container.
5. **100 µL M-Wash**, spin 30 s.
6. **200 µL L-Desulphonation Buffer**, stand **15 min** at room temp, spin 30 s. Meanwhile warm the DNA Elution Buffer to 56 °C.
7. **200 µL M-Wash**, spin 30 s. Repeat, spinning **2 min** the second time.
8. Move the column to a 1.5 mL tube. Add **8 µL warm Elution Buffer** to the membrane, wait 5 min, spin 30 s. Keep on ice and check all tubes have the same volume.

**PrepAmp (random priming)**

9. Master mixes (× *n*), on ice:

   | Mix | Per sample |
   |---|---|
   | **PMM** (priming) | 2 µL 5× PrepAmp Buffer + 1 µL 40 µM PrepAmp Primer |
   | **PAMM** (PrepAmp) | 1 µL 5× PrepAmp Buffer + 3.75 µL PrepAmp Pre-mix + 0.3 µL PrepAmp Polymerase |
   | **Diluted polymerase** | 0.3 µL PrepAmp Polymerase + 0.2 µL Elution Buffer (so you add 0.5 µL) |

10. **7 µL converted DNA + 3 µL PMM** in new strips. Vortex, spin, and start the priming program:

    | Step | Temp / time |
    |---|---|
    | Denature | 98 °C 2 min → 8 °C 1 min → **8 °C hold** |
    | ① At the hold | Take tubes out, vortex/spin, add **5.05 µL PAMM**, vortex/spin, return and continue |
    | Priming | 8 °C 4 min, then 16, 22, 28, 36, 36.5 °C for 1 min each (3% ramp), 37 °C 8 min |
    | Repeat | Denature → hold again |
    | ② At the hold | Add **0.5 µL diluted polymerase**, vortex/spin, continue the priming steps |

**DNA Clean & Concentrator (DCC) 1**

11. Add the whole priming reaction (~15.5 µL) to **108.85 µL DNA Binding Buffer** (7:1), vortex, load a spin column, spin 30 s.
12. **200 µL DNA Wash**, spin 30 s; repeat with a **2 min** spin.
13. Elute in **12 µL warm Elution Buffer** (5 min, spin 30 s).

**Amplification 1**

14. Per sample: **12.5 µL 2× Library Amp Mix + 1 µL 10 µM Library Amp Primers** (13.5 µL) + **11.5 µL DCC eluate**.
15. Run Amp 1 with **8 cycles** for 10 ng input (10 cycles for 1 ng) (~30 min).

**DCC 2**

16. **25 µL** reaction + **175 µL DNA Binding Buffer** (7:1). Bind, wash 2× as above, elute in **12.5 µL** warm Elution Buffer.

**Amplification 2 (indexing)**

17. Per sample: **12 µL DNA + 14 µL 2× Library Amp Mix + 1 µL i5 + 1 µL i7** (10 µM). Tick each addition off on a sheet as you go.
18. Run Amp 2 with **10 cycles** for 10 ng input (12 for 1 ng) (~30 min). Take the KAPA beads out of the fridge now.

**1× bead cleanup**

19. Beads at room temp (≥ 30 min), swirled not vortexed. Make **fresh 80% ethanol**.
20. Add **26 µL beads** (1×) to each library. Pipette-mix ≥ 10× and rotate **15 min at 200 rpm**.
21. On the magnet, wait until clear, then remove the supernatant.
22. Wash **2× with 200 µL 80% ethanol** without disturbing the beads. Remove all residual liquid with a P20 and air-dry ~1 min.
23. Off the magnet, resuspend in **15 µL Elution Buffer**, shake 5 min at 200 rpm, return to the magnet and transfer the clear eluate to labeled final tubes (sample, date, "lib", initials).

::: {.callout-tip}
## ⏸ Safe stopping point
Libraries can go to −20 °C here if you're not doing QC the same day.
:::

## QC and expected results

| Check | Method | Good result |
|---|---|---|
| Concentration | Qubit dsDNA BR, read twice and average | > 5 ng µL⁻¹ (re-amplify below that, see below) |
| Size | D5000 TapeStation | Smooth peak in the same range as the other libraries; no library with a very different size profile |

In the Thermal Transplant preps, libraries came out at about 3–22 ng µL⁻¹. An example of a good trace that was sequenced:

![](/images/20210415_18-9.png){fig-alt="TapeStation D5000 trace of a good WGBS library" width=70%}

### Rescue: re-amplify low-yield libraries (< 5 ng µL⁻¹)

Repeat Amp 2 + bead cleanup with **4 cycles**: **12 µL library + 13 µL 2× Library Amp Mix + 1 µL combined i5/i7** (the **same** indexes as before), then a 1× bead cleanup. In 2021 this brought most low libraries to 7–27 ng µL⁻¹. A few libraries that read "too low" stayed too low and need to be re-prepped from DNA.

## Troubleshooting

| Problem | Likely cause | Fix |
|---|---|---|
| Library fails (Qubit "too low") | Unequal elution after conversion, or sample loss in the cleanups | Check volumes after step 8; elute slowly onto the membrane center |
| Less than 15.5 µL after priming | Evaporation (priming program has a low lid temperature) | Expected; transfer everything into the binding buffer |
| 0.3 µL polymerase doesn't leave the tip | Volume too small | Use the diluted polymerase (0.5 µL) |
| Library yield < 5 ng µL⁻¹ | Low input or efficiency | Re-amplify with 4 cycles (above) |
